messages:
melissa: FYI: new tier-preservation policy for the upcoming rate migration pushed to draft. Need ops + billing signoff by EOD Fri. Short summary below.

kai: quick q — does this preserve credits/pricing for legacy monthly customers?

melissa: yes. Policy preserves the effective per-customer unit price for active customers for 6 months (180 days), then moves them to the new tier. Rough estimate: ~3.2% net revenue delta. Spreadsheet + scenarios: https://redwood.internal/drive/tiers/preserve-draft

aditi: ok, can we explicitly exclude reserved-capacity contracts from the preservation? don't want double discounts.

marcus: +1 on reserved exclusion. also: we must not flip billing variants for customers currently in AB tests. That would invalidate experiments.

melissa: good points. I added clause 4: "don't change billing variant for customers with active AB tags". Snippet of config for ops: 
```
tier_preservation:
  duration_days: 180
  skip_reserved: true
  skip_ab_experiment: true
```

billing-bot: billing-runner notifying: migration script would patch ~12k accounts if enabled. Dry-run command sample: `./scripts/migrate_rates --dry-run --cohort=preserve-180`

aditi: what's the QA plan for invoices? we need invoice-diff checks and a guard so nobody gets a negative-charge slip.

kai: finance to run reconciliation query. example to run in reporting DB: 
```
SELECT account_id, old_rate, new_rate, qty, (new_rate-old_rate)*qty as delta
FROM migrations
WHERE cohort='preserve-180' AND migrated=false;
```

melissa: action items (capturing here):
- @aditi run invoice diffs and edge-case checks by Thu 10am
- @kai coordinate ops deploy window (prefer Sat 02:00 UTC)
- @marcus update AB-flagging list and share in channel
- @billing-bot run staging dry-run Fri 21:00 UTC and upload results

aditi: ack. I'll also prepare a short rollback playbook at /docs/rate-migration/rollback.md and ping SRE for runbook review.

kai: ops constraint: Sat 02:00 UTC works, but EMEA customers may see small blips. Suggest limiting concurrency to 200 c/s. Use flag `--concurrency=200` in script.

melissa: approved for 200 c/s. finance ok with the rate. We still need legal signoff on minor TOS wording.

jonathan: legal reviewed — ok overall. One wording tweak: change "customers actively under a paid contract" -> "customers with active financial commitments". I'll push that change to the doc.

marcus: rollout plan: staging dry-run -> 10-account canary -> ramp 10x every 30 minutes (monitor invoice diffs and error rates). If invoice diff > $100 in any batch, abort and rollback.

melissa: great. I'll consolidate and open a PR to the ops runbook with the config snippet + playbook. If no blockers, I'll request product signoff tomorrow morning. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
